seo.title: 7-Day Northern Morocco Tour from Tangier to Marrakech | Chefchaouen & Fes (2026)
seo.metaDescription: From €690 pp. 7-day tour from Tangier to Marrakech via Chefchaouen, Roman Volubilis, medieval Fes & High Atlas. Private VIP transport & certified city guides.
seo.lead: This seven-day overland journey is built for travelers arriving in Tangier—whether by ferry from Spain or by air—who want to travel all the way south to Marrakech. Starting where the Atlantic meets the Mediterranean at Cap Spartel, you explore Tangier's old medina before heading into the Rif Mountains via Tetouan to spend a night in the blue-painted town of Chefchaouen.
seo.primaryKeyword: 7 day northern Morocco tour from Tangier

price.label: From EUR 690 per person
price.note: Includes private A/C vehicle with multilingual driver-guide, 6 nights in boutique riads and hotels (Tangier, Chefchaouen, 2 nights Fes, 2 nights Marrakech), licensed local guides in Fes and Marrakech, arrival/departure transfers, and daily breakfasts from Day 2.

seo.imageAlt: Sunlit blue medina alley of Chefchaouen on a 7-day northern Morocco expedition from Tangier to Marrakech
highlights: Visit Cap Spartel, the Caves of Hercules, and the historic Kasbah in Tangier
Walk through Tetouan's UNESCO medina and the blue-washed alleys of Chefchaouen
Explore the Roman mosaics of Volubilis and the gates of imperial Meknes
Full-day guided walking tour of Fes el-Bali with a licensed local expert
Spot wild Barbary macaques in the Middle Atlas cedar forests of Azrou
Conclude in Marrakech with a private guided visit to Bahia Palace, Saadian Tombs, and Jemaa el-Fna

faqs.question: Can you pick us up directly from the ferry port in Tangier?
faqs.answer: Yes. Whether you arrive by fast ferry from Tarifa at Tangier City Port, via Tanger Med Port, or at Tangier Airport (TNG), your driver will meet you right outside customs with a personalized sign.

faqs.question: Is this a good route if we are coming from Spain?
faqs.answer: Yes. It is the most logical north-to-south route through Morocco, allowing you to take the ferry across the Strait of Gibraltar, explore the north and the imperial cities, and fly home directly from Marrakech without backtracking.

faqs.question: How long are the daily drives?
faqs.answer: Most driving legs average 3 to 4.5 hours along good highways and scenic mountain roads. The only long travel day is Day 5 (Fes to Marrakech, ~7 hours), broken up with stops in Ifrane and the Azrou cedar forest.

faqs.question: Are local city guides included in Fes and Marrakech?
faqs.answer: Yes. Licensed local guides are included for dedicated walking tours in both Fes and Marrakech so you get rich historical insight and navigate the medinas effortlessly.

faqs.question: Can we add a Sahara Desert night to this itinerary?
faqs.answer: Yes. If you have 8 or 9 days available, we can route you from Fes through the Ziz Valley to Merzouga for a camel trek and desert camp stay before continuing to Marrakech.
